0.content: General of the Tenryou Commission and Heizou's direct superior. She has "few positive words" for him: he chases his own schemes, keeps vanishing and once had to be found through a private detective agency. The only reason she has not reined him in is that he delivers results. He finds her the most serious person in the Commission and wishes she would give everyone breathing room. He also defends her fiercely: when rumours said she signed Ryuuji's conviction to please the Kujou Clan, he showed that she had in fact commuted Ryuuji's death sentence to temporary detention, the most a principled officer could do under pressure. When the Traveler vouched for him, she made the Traveler his temporary supervisor and handed him Sango's complaint letter.

1.comment: Shikanoin Heizou: Sango and the Bantan Sango Detective Agency
1.content: Heizou and Sango "struck an instant chord" and founded the "Bantan Sango & Heizou Detective Agency" in Hanamizaka, Inazuma City. They split because Sango believes a detective's whole mission is the truth, while Heizou believes something can matter more than the truth: stopping harm before it happens. His name was taken off the sign. Today Sango says she would be happiest if he went missing for a hundred years, calls him a yappy dog in her path to the "Temple of Truth", and writes complaint letters about him. Her assistant Ryuuji, an orphan and former Doushin, is fond of Heizou but keeps his distance in public at Sango's request.

2.content: A shrine maiden at the Grand Narukami Shrine and Heizou's older, distant cousin (their surnames share the characters for "wild deer"). She also chases the runaway ninja Sayu, and says Sayu can be an even bigger headache than Heizou. She remembers him as a rule-breaker who was always in trouble, never expected him to become a detective, and complains she can never find him. He calls her "cuz" and explains himself to her patiently, a rare thing for him, to keep her out of trouble. When she was ready to march on the Commission over his lack of promotion, he talked her down with a joke about the hairs on the back of his hand: inmates who know his name outnumber those who know any Yoriki. She is his link to his father: he sent his tournament medal through her.

3.comment: Shikanoin Heizou: The Vision and the Green Pebble
3.content: Heizou rarely talks about his unhappy childhood. At a festival he befriended a bright boy who claimed to be a rich merchant's son and brought him books from Sumeru and toys from Fontaine. As they grew up, Heizou noticed the boy's filthy clothes, asked him outright, and learned everything was stolen, and that they had first met because the boy meant to rob him. Heizou ended the friendship and threw out every gift except one of a pair of green pebbles the two had fished from a stream. A year later, at the same festival, he found his friend collapsed in his own blood, stabbed by a ruffian who tried to steal his purse. The purse held no Mora, only the other green pebble. Dying, the friend said he had come to see Heizou too.

4.comment: Shikanoin Heizou: "Cyclone" and the Police Station Jail
4.content: At the Police Station Jail the best-known name is not any Yoriki's or the General's, or even, in there, the Raiden Shogun's, but Doushin Shikanoin Heizou's. Crooks blamed "that detective" for their capture until they learned he was one man who had caught countless skilled criminals. They decided he must be something more than human, and stopped speaking ill of him. Even crime lords now use a pseudonym for him, "Cyclone", which petty criminals explain as "a calamity, a plague upon all us crooks." He has refused promotion so that his name keeps spreading. When he joined, he levelled the backlog of cold cases, "Mt. Coldcase", for practice.

5.comment: Shikanoin Heizou: Watatsumi Island and the Missing Thing
5.content: Hangout Event (2.8). Heizou disappeared, and the Tenryou Commission discreetly commissioned the Bantan Sango Detective Agency to find him; Ryuuji passed the job to the Traveler. They found him on Watatsumi, having let Nobushi "capture" him to study them. He was chasing a dream he had had on his first night there during the war: "Something vital is missing on this island." Nobushi loot pointed to raided caravans. Gorou blamed a Ritou merchant, but Heizou sensed a lie. Tailing caravan chief Todoroki by night, they found smuggled medicinal herbs (Qingxin, Glaze Lilies) that Watatsumi's soldiers had "seized", and heard from captured Nobushi that 'pirates' on a massive ship, captained by an eye-patched woman, had taken a load of Sango Pearls and Crystal Marrow off them.
